gate0_pit.detail: Automated detector CLEAN on run_s5_mutation.R (64 lines) and factor_engine.R (172 lines). Manual C1-C11 review: (C1) IC uses expanding window with 2-month lag, NOT full-sample — CLEAN. (C2) VT expanding vol uses [1:(i-1)] + 1-period lag; DD uses dd_lag = c(0, dd_pct[-n_f]) — CLEAN. (C8) No FM overlay. (C10) Liquidity shift(1L, lag) — CLEAN. (C11) No FRED data. (C13) Z_Score_Aligned only. (C14) ic_cutoff = sig_d - 2 months, strict PIT.

gate1_performance.detail: SR=0.835, CAGR=10.91%, MDD=25.76%, IR=0.121, Calmar=0.423. Beats BM (SR 0.427, MDD 52.92%) on risk-adjusted basis. CAGR below 16% target. MDD marginally above 25% threshold (25.76%). Stress defense 3/3 outperform. Score 44.5 = Grade B. Hard fail not triggered.

gate2_stage_artifacts.detail: All required artifacts present: s0_record (Scout hypothesis), s1_construction, s2_profile (Grade C, FAIL on MDD+OOS), s3_orthogonality (novelty=0.306, top3 corr 0.688-0.698 to Grade A), s4_integration (delta_sharpe=0.331, role=core_alpha, admission=S6). S5 mutation script and output present.

gate3_role_honesty.detail: S4 claims core_alpha (delta_sharpe=0.331, kospi_beat=TRUE). However, actual S5 metrics contradict: IR=0.121 (near zero alpha vs BM), CAGR 10.91% vs BM 9.03% (only +1.88% excess), BM_Corr=0.677 (high). Hurdle gate itself reclassified as 'diversifier'. The strategy tracks the benchmark too closely for core_alpha designation. S2 profile FF5 alpha t=-1.14 confirms no independent alpha. Role dishonesty: claimed core_alpha, actual diversifier.

gate4_statistical.detail: OOS retention = 0.552 (IS SR 0.973 / OOS SR 0.537). Below 0.7 threshold for robust strategies — indicates IS overfitting. S2 base had even worse OOS 0.13. S5 mutation improved OOS from 0.13 to 0.55 but still concerning. DSR not available. Rolling 3Y Sharpe >0 ratio 88.4% is acceptable. Alpha trend ratio 1.04 stable. Max consecutive negative alpha months = 6.

gate5_ff5.detail: S2 profile: FF5 alpha = -3.94% (t = -1.14). Negative alpha after controlling for Fama-French 5 factors. The strategy's returns are fully explained by standard factor exposures. No independent alpha generation confirmed. FMB t-stat 1.71 < 3.0 Harvey threshold.

fail_reasons: Gate 3 FAIL: Role dishonesty — claimed core_alpha, actual diversifier (IR=0.121, BM_Corr=0.677)
Gate 4 FAIL: OOS retention 0.552 below 0.7 threshold — IS overfitting detected
Gate 5 FAIL: FF5 alpha = -3.94% (t=-1.14) — no independent alpha, Harvey t<3.0
verdict.recommendation: REJECT for promotion. Strategy improved from S2 (Grade C, OOS 0.13) to S5 (Grade B, OOS 0.55) via VT+DD overlay, but fundamental problems remain: (1) No FF5 alpha — returns fully explained by factor loadings. (2) IC-based rotation converges to consensus factors (C19 dominant per S2 key_insight). (3) Alpha decay problem NOT solved — expanding ICIR weighting does not generate orthogonal alpha. Lineage shows high correlation to STR_1393/1397/1398 (>0.88) — redundant. Salvageable only as defensive diversifier sleeve, NOT core alpha.

role_honesty_audit.evidence: S4 artifact claims core_alpha with delta_sharpe=0.331. But S5 realized IR=0.121, BM_Corr=0.677, CAGR excess only +1.88% over BM. Hurdle gate reclassified to diversifier. FF5 alpha negative. The delta_sharpe in S4 was inflated by including the BM-correlated return component. True incremental alpha near zero.
